elements.title: Cupons Utilizados
elements.commandsql:
SELECT u.id as u_id,
       u.firstname,
       u.lastname, 
       u.email, 
       c.id AS course_id,
       c.fullname, 
       coupon.uniquekey AS coupon_codigo, 
       coupon.value AS desconto, 
       m.lasttime  AS data_uso
FROM mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment m
JOIN mdl_local_kopere_pay_coupon coupon ON m.coupon = coupon.uniquekey
JOIN mdl_course               c ON m.course = c.id
JOIN mdl_user                 u ON m.userid = u.id

elements.title: Cupons não Utilizados
elements.commandsql:
SELECT
    c.uniquekey,
    c.amount,
    c.value,
    c.time
FROM mdl_local_kopere_pay_coupon c
LEFT JOIN mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment m ON c.uniquekey = m.coupon
WHERE m.coupon IS NULL
ORDER BY c.time DESC
